candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to return 502 and gateway checkout to fail with 502. Traces show payment 503 errors across all three correlation IDs while inventory reservations succeed.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side telemetry absent; the 503 origin within payment is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s trace to order returning 502, which traces to payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory reservations succeed. Payment-side evidence is missing, so the bounded candidate is payment-origin 5xx surfaced as http-500.
missing_evidence: Payment service traces/logs/metrics for /v1/authorizations to confirm the 503 source
Order service telemetry to confirm it propagates payment failure as 502
